decision_state.promotion_eligibility: pending 500 games / 60 dates and every frozen gate in the prereg

PURPOSE: confirmed-starter transport test. The one legitimate unresolved question: does clean T-90 confirmed-starter information perform better than the leakage-safe but noisier historical identity state (the HISTORICAL STARTER-IDENTITY MEASUREMENT LIMITATION)? This run answers that and nothing else. It does not rehabilitate the failed development result and may never be narrated as doing so.

ELIGIBILITY_FROZEN.rule: starter identity CONFIRMED at T-90 minutes before scheduled first pitch, both sides, from a tier-1 capture that says CONFIRMED — a probables/preview board is PROJECTED and does NOT qualify
ELIGIBILITY_FROZEN.excluded_and_counted: PROJECTED and UNKNOWN starters exclude the game from V14 scoring; every exclusion is recorded with its class. League-average substitution never produces a V14 forecast at all (stricter than the card, which may display CAP rows for tracking).
ELIGIBILITY_FROZEN.example_from_today: the 2026-08-18 owner probables board and the matchup-preview board are both PROJECTED class. NO 8/18 game is V14-eligible unless a T-90 CONFIRMED capture arrives before its first pitch.

REGISTRATION_FROZEN.one_immutable_probability: exactly one V14 probability per eligible game, registered pre-pitch through forecast_registry (hash chain), cohort V14_FORWARD, never revised, never superseded by a later capture
REGISTRATION_FROZEN.no_selective_registration: if a slate has eligible games, ALL eligible games register — never a subset chosen by lines, apparent edge, or model confidence. A slate where registration is impossible is recorded as such.
REGISTRATION_FROZEN.not_pooled: V14_FORWARD grades against tier-1 FINAL evidence only, alongside (never pooled with) the V13 cohorts on the same games

COMPARISON_FROZEN: identical-game comparison against all four development comparators: raw V13 (the live card probability for the same game), Platt-calibrated V13 (calibration fit on data strictly before the forward window start, frozen at first use), expanding home-rate, and the no-starter ablation (park-only pipeline, weights refit per slate date on pre-date data exactly as V14's are). Same Holm family as the prereg.
CHECKPOINTS: descriptive only, at 100/250/500 games: counts, scores, calibration — no interim significance claims, no tuning, no narrative promotion. The 500-game/60-date evaluation is the only inferential read.
V19_INDEPENDENCE: V14 and V19 are evaluated independently. If both ever pass their gates, replacement requires a preregistered prospective HEAD-TO-HEAD; neither inherits the other's evidence.
TERMINOLOGY_BINDING: per docs/experiments/2026-08-18_V14_WORDING_CORRECTIONS.json: the historical identity issue is a MEASUREMENT LIMITATION, not leakage; the development fit is ONE analytical result from two deterministic executions.
